summary: ReactiveUI integration for Mopups popup views, navigation operations, and popup lifecycle event streams in .NET MAUI.
recommendedPatterns: Use ReactivePopupPage<TViewModel> for strongly typed popups.
Subscribe once to cold navigation operations and scope hot event subscriptions.
avoidPatterns: Do not assume a popup navigation observable starts before subscription.
Do not subscribe repeatedly to the same cold push/pop operation.
Do not leave global popup event subscriptions undisposed.
setupSteps: Create generated ReactiveUI view models and ReactivePopupPage views, then bind inside WhenActivated.
commonPitfalls: Cold navigation operations execute once per subscription.
Popup navigation uses a stack separate from normal MAUI navigation.

packageSelection: Use ReactiveUI.Maui.Plugins.Popup for direct ReactiveUI/Mopups integration.
Use Sextant.Plugins.Popup only when the application standardizes navigation behind Sextant.
sourceGeneratorGuidance: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators for popup view-model properties and commands and generated IViewFor registration where supported.
Keep popup navigation runtime-based because stack changes are dynamic.
compatibilityNotes: Current examples may show System.Reactive Unit; new code should use the lean ReactiveUI/Primitives command types unless full Rx compatibility is required.
Cold operations require subscription; hot event streams exist independently of subscribers.
migrationGuidance: Replace System.Reactive Unit and scheduler types with RxVoid/ISequencer in lean popup view models, or choose the matching ReactiveUI .Reactive family only for full compatibility.
Move popup bindings into WhenActivated and dispose event subscriptions with the view lifecycle.
